name: craked.dev

sources.title: Homepage — live builder leaderboard scoring GitHub shipping velocity, stars, and products built
Products — 'Products Built by Developers' directory with a 'Ship a Product' entry point; showed 0 shipped at fetch time
How Cracked Score Works — products are added via Settings and domain-verified for +100 pts each

conditions: Requires signing in with GitHub — the score and product listing are built on a verified GitHub identity
Products must pass domain verification (matching GitHub profiles, portfolio links, or DNS TXT records)
requirements: A GitHub account — sign-in is GitHub OAuth ('Sign in with GitHub and claim your builder card')
Product must have a live domain that can be verified via GitHub profile links, portfolio links, or DNS TXT record
The platform scores builders, not products directly — a product is attached to the maker's verified profile
preparation: GitHub account with real public activity (commits, PRs, stars feed the score)
Live product domain you control — be ready to add a DNS TXT record or link it from your GitHub profile
Product category for the directory (AI/ML, SaaS, DevTools, Open Source, Web3, Mobile, Design, TypeScript, Rust, Python)
workflow: Sign in with GitHub via /auth/login or the 'Get started' / 'Get Scored' buttons
A builder profile is created and scored from public repo metadata (commits, PRs, stars, followers)
Go to Settings and add the product URL
Verify ownership — crawler checks GitHub profile match, portfolio links, or DNS TXT (+100 pts per verified domain, +40 for a reachable link)
Product then appears in the /products directory via 'Ship a Product' and on the builder profile
watchFor: Products directory showed '0 Shipped' — the platform is very early; low traffic is likely
This is a builder-score leaderboard, not a launch board — value is the profile + verified product listing, not a launch-day spike
Score uses public repo metadata only; private-repo-only builders will score low
Part of a cross-promoted launch network: badges for Startup Fame, Startup Fast, FoundrList, ScrollLaunch, neeed.directory, MarketingDB
countsAsLive: The product appears on craked.dev/products and on the builder's profile page with a verified-domain marker
unknowns: Whether 'Ship a Product' adds the product immediately or after re-verification
Whether an unverified product still appears in the directory
